'''Yoki Tenman Shrine''' (與喜天満神社) is a {{ill|Shinto shrine|en|Shinto shrine|qid=Q845945|lt=Shinto shrine}} located in {{ill|Hase|ja|初瀬|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Hase, Sakurai|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q11396531}}, {{ill|Sakurai, Nara|en|Sakurai, Nara|qid=Q127026|lt=Sakurai}}, {{ill|Nara Prefecture|en|Nara Prefecture|qid=Q131287|lt=Nara}}. Its former Rank was {{ill|Gō-sha|ja|郷社|qid=Q134917316}}{{efn|District Shrines|WD=Q90139226|lt=Ken-sha|1=modern system of ranked Shinto shrines|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/village shrine|qq=ja_comment|qid=Q134917316|qq= 近代社格制度|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q712534}}.

== Deities ==
; Main deity
* {{ill|Sugawara no Michizane|en|Sugawara no Michizane|qid=Q382005|lt=Sugawara no Michizane}} (Sugawara no Michizane)

; Additional Deities
* [[Amaterasu]] (天照大神)
* [[Ōkurahime no Kami]] (大倉姫神)

== History ==
The shrine is located in {{ill|Hase|ja|初瀬|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Hase, Sakurai|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q11396531}}, believed to be the birthplace of {{ill|Nomi no Sukune|en|Nomi no Sukune|qid=Q965742|lt=Nomino Sukune}}, the ancestor of the {{ill|Haji clan|en|Haji clan|qid=Q10927758|lt=Haji clan}}, later known as the Sugawara Clan. This historical connection made the area significant for the Sugawara family.<ref name="Sakurai Tourism Association">{{Cite web|url=https://sakurai-kankou.jimdo.com/%E5%90%8D%E6%89%80%E6%97%A7%E8%B7%A1/%E5%88%9D%E7%80%AC%E9%81%93%E5%91%A8%E8%BE%BA/%E8%88%87%E5%96%9C%E5%A4%A9%E6%BA%80%E7%A5%9E%E7%A4%BE/|title=Yoki Tenman Shrine (Sakurai, Hase)|publisher=Sakurai City Tourism Association|access-date=April 23, 2019}}</ref> According to the ''{{ill|Hasedera Genki|ja|長谷寺験記|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Hasedera Genki|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}}'', the shrine was founded in 946 CE (Tenkei 9) and later became venerated as the guardian shrine of Hase.<ref name="Sakurai Tourism Association" />

== Sub-Shrines ==
* Taki-no-Kura Gongen Shrine (deity: [[Kumano Gongen|Hayatama-no-Mikoto]], [[Izanagi]], {{ill|Izanami|en|Izanami|qid=Q682306|lt=Izanami}})
* Shiradaijin Shrine (deity: {{ill|Watarai Haruhiko|ja|度会春彦|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Watarai Haruhiko|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}})
* Sakuraha Shrine (deity: {{ill|Iyo Shinnō|ja|伊予親王|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Iyo Shinnō|13=User:Immanuelle/Iyo Shinnō|qq=}})
* Hachioji Shrine (deity: [[Amaterasu]], [[Susanoo-no-Mikoto]])

== Cultural Properties ==
=== Important Cultural Properties ===
* Wooden Seated Statue of Tenjin
: Known as "Wrathful Tenjin," this seated statue in court attire is made of {{ill|Buddha in art|ja|寄木造|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/yosegi-zukuri|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 仏像|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q1000809}} and features an intense expression. It bears an inscription from Shogen 1 (1259), making it the oldest surviving sculpture of Tenjin in Japan.<ref name="Nara News">{{Cite web|url=https://www.nara-np.co.jp/news/20120421085721.html|title=Important Cultural Properties Newly Designated: Tenjin Seated Statue (Yoki Tenman Shrine)|publisher=Nara Newspaper|access-date=April 23, 2019}}</ref> Within the statue's head is a mirror engraved with an image of {{ill|Ekādaśamukha|en|Ekādaśamukha|qid=Q11404731|lt=Jūichimen Kannon}}, symbolizing Tenjin's connection to the deity.<ref>{{Cite journal|title=New Cultural Property Designations|journal=Monthly Cultural Properties|issue=585|page=17|publisher=Agency for Cultural Affairs|year=2012}}</ref> Previously enshrined in the main hall, it is now housed in the {{ill|Nara National Museum|en|Nara National Museum|qid=Q147312|lt=Nara National Museum}}.<ref name="Nara News" />

=== Additional Cultural Assets ===
[[File:Samurai O-Yoroi 2.jpg|thumb|200px|Reference: White-Threaded Yoroi (owned by {{ill|Hase-dera|en|Hase-dera|qid=Q1457787|lt=Hasedera}}, displayed at the {{ill|Tokyo National Museum|en|Tokyo National Museum|qid=Q653433|lt=Tokyo National Museum}})]]
Five sets of important cultural property armor (White-Threaded Yoroi, Red-Threaded Yoroi, Hawk Feather Yoroi, Three-Eyed Plate Yoroi, Blue-Laced Armor) were once associated with Yoki Tenman Shrine, which served as {{ill|Hase-dera|en|Hase-dera|qid=Q1457787|lt=Hasedera}}'s {{ill|Chinjugami|en|Chinjugami|qid=Q97479976|lt=Chinjugami}}. These were gifted by {{ill|Kitabatake Norikata|ja|北畠教謙|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kitabatake Norikata|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}} in 1560 (Eiroku 3) for services rendered in battles against {{ill|Matsunaga Hisahide|en|Matsunaga Hisahide|qid=Q1143038|lt=Matsunaga Hisahide}}.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://kunishitei.bunka.go.jp/heritage/detail/201/7051|title=White-Threaded Yoroi (Detailed Listing)|publisher=Agency for Cultural Affairs|access-date=December 1, 2019}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://kunishitei.bunka.go.jp/heritage/detail/201/7047|title=Red-Threaded Yoroi (Detailed Listing)|publisher=Agency for Cultural Affairs|access-date=December 1, 2019}}</ref>

== Access ==
* Nearest station: 25 minutes on foot from {{ill|Hasedera Station|en|Hasedera Station|qid=Q5678737|lt=Hasedera Station}}, {{ill|Osaka Line|en|Osaka Line|qid=Q1052545|lt=Kintetsu Osaka Line}}.
